name: Lower Blackrock Spire has one of Chop'gog, Razmorg and Wizz'Magg per run
contract: Chop'gog the Butcher (9219), Razmorg the Decapitator (9218) and Wizz'Magg the Magus (9217) share one spawn pool
with max_limit 1: on Normal and on Mythic exactly one of them is up in a Lower Blackrock Spire instance. All three
stand in the same map grid, so a player inside loads every candidate.

steps.label: CONTROL: normal is in a Normal Lower Blackrock Spire
CONTROL: mythic is in a Mythic Lower Blackrock Spire
Normal: exactly one of the three rares is up
Mythic: exactly one of the three rares is up
